title: Near extremal RN-AdS control of holographic Josephson transport
summary: We formulate a holographic weak-link construction in which Josephson transport is controlled by the charge sector of a Reissner--Nordstrom-AdS black brane. The model is an Einstein-Maxwell-charged-scalar theory in asymptotically AdS$_4$, with a spatially inhomogeneous boundary chemical potential that creates two superconducting banks separated by a normal or weakly superconducting barrier.
